== Notes ==
* Although there is immediate visual indication of rocks hitting the ground, the first damage and [[knock down]] event does not occur until 3 seconds after the spell has been cast.
** Since the earliest knock down occurs after the first 3 seconds, it is recommended that foes are [[Snare_(tactic)|snared]] when the spell is cast.
* If knock down length is increased to 3 seconds (from [[Earthbind]] or a [[Stonefist Insignia]]), then foes will either be knocked down two times with a 3 second delay, two times with a perfect [[quarterknock]], or three times with two perfect quarterknocks.
* This is one of the few spells that makes full use of [[Glyph of Energy]].
* Be wary of foes using this skill against your party, especially if it is composed of mostly [[henchmen]] and [[hero]]es, as they will all stand in approximately the range of the attack (unless you order them to move), devastating your party.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] is featured in the Series 2 [[Skill Pin]] set.
